run_compute_empirical_mu: run compute_empirical_mu to calculate empirical mu for Flux2 timestep scheduling based on image sequence length and number of steps
run_retrieve_timesteps: run retrieve_timesteps to set scheduler timesteps and retrieve the timestep schedule for Flux2 inference
build_flux2_set_timesteps_step: build Flux2SetTimestepsStep to set scheduler timesteps for Flux2 inference using empirical mu calculation
build_flux2_prepare_latents_step: build Flux2PrepareLatentsStep to prepare initial noise latents and position IDs for Flux2 text-to-image generation
build_flux2_prepare_guidance_step: build Flux2PrepareGuidanceStep to prepare the guidance scale tensor for Flux2 inference
